master.policy: Supplemental integration payload only. Root integrator must re-read/CAS the master, preserve all records and refresh source identities after runtime changes.

inputs.scope: Bounded default authored review of 15 unique body/definition clips mapping to 18 catalogue contexts. Evidence measures interchange, sampled skin geometry and adjacent transforms; it does not approve contact, clinical appropriateness, native dynamics or entire product playback.

limitations: Probe samples five exact phase clocks and must not be described as a dense current clearance audit.
The pitch90/110 alternatives remain unqualified diagnostic candidates in the raw probe; their outcomes do not set acceptance tolerances.
Older Blender geometry has its own source identity. Preserve that identity and later capture-only lineage explicitly.
Native tracking, loaded force/compression and clinical acceptance are unqualified.

palm.scope: Existing full-cycle Hand/Mid1/Index1/Pinky1 marker drift bound, preserved.

knee.scope: Existing bilateral knee horizontal support bound, preserved; vertical skin support is separate.

held.scope: Existing prepared playback local-rotation comparison allowance; not an anatomical ROM claim.

newFlexionSkin.scope: Predeclared visual-engineering correction criterion for this new bounded flexion task, approved before candidate integration. Not an inherited universal skin gate, pressure/compression tolerance, source-reference limit or GLB exchange allowance. Every designated knee/shin/dorsal-foot/toe and palm region also requires a supported witness; a globally lifted floating body cannot pass by clearance alone.
newFlexionSkin.supportGapReason: Contact-gap bound has not been numerically justified for the new kneeling support; report signed witness gaps and preserve visual review rather than inventing a tolerance.

unchangedPriorGates.scope: These existing prone and exchange checks remain unchanged and apply only to their existing scopes.

clinical.scope: Use unchanged modeled bounds and stricter patient ranges in production and verification; no empirical candidate extrema become new bounds.
clinical.notes: Weight-bearing dorsiflexion allowance is a separate existing policy; do not silently apply it to dorsal-foot kneeling. Verify all other modeled channels using the registry.

setup.intent: Prepared quadruped with fixed palms and bilateral lower-leg support.

motion.intent: Coordinated hips-back progression, palm and lower-leg support retained, spine/head accounted for.

hold.intent: Preserve the achieved supported configuration; no guide drift while source posture is held.

return.intent: Reverse to the prepared quadruped without palm slide or foot penetration.

loop.intent: Compare exact terminal and prepared initial states; no extra forward duration or invented sampler phase.
